Interface PoolChat.Sink

All Known Implementing Classes:
AmwpFacade.PoolSink, AmwpFacade.TextSink
Enclosing interface:
PoolChat
public static interface PoolChat.Sink
The Sink interface receives chunks and then one completion. done(String, String) carries a reason and a message. An empty reason is success, and the message is the concatenated assistant text.

    • done

      void done(String reason, String message) throws Exception
      The method receives the completion for one prompt. An empty reason means success. Any other reason is pool down, pool payload, pool auth, pool tool refused, or pool parse.
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is empty on success. Otherwise it is one of the five pool reasons.
      message - The message is the assistant text, or the short failure line.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the frame could not be sent.
